bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge BigBang
bricks.description: Independent Editor installer with passive local Steamworks.NET checks and explicit pinned acquisition/reconciliation before initial Install God. Public assembly APIs and an older-Editor native import compile guard fix compilation without expanding the supported installation baseline. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 120 tests pass in each of wrapper-absent and wrapper-installed fixtures; Unity 6000.3.24f1 compile/import-guard probe passes. No native Steam, client or AppID is required for local checks. Window source is unchanged; prior appearance evidence is historical. Consumers update manually.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Commandments Compatibility

Adds per-release capabilities, documentation gating and compile-checked examples; God/vendor-absent checks pass. Unity 6000.6.3f1 Editor: 4 passed, zero failed, 0 conditional checks skipped. bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge God
bricks.description: God remains the only mandatory shared brick. Fixes Git update metadata failures in deeply nested Windows projects by enabling long paths for owned Git processes and lazy package manifest reads, preserving user Git settings and credentials. Neutral platform contracts and optional-brick boundaries are retained. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 386 unique passing Editor checks across a full suite and an 85-test focused rerun; 11 conditional fixture checks skipped. A full-run completion-log assertion passed on the focused rerun. Real filtered fetches and long-path manifest reads verified. No UI implementation change; physical input and alternate skin/DPI acceptance remain unverified. Consumers update manually.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Steam
bricks.description: Optional Windows x64 Mono preparation with passive inspection, reviewed defaults, shared findings, build checks and default-off local native activation. Requires God 0.37.0; other Forge peers remain optional. Exact Steamworks.NET 2025.164.1 profile is provisioned explicitly in the project. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 25 Editor and 4 injected Play Mode checks passed, zero failed or skipped. Actual standalone/embedded normal/narrow UI, Help, blocked Save and Undo reviewed. Current wrapper-present/absent Windows players run unconfigured without native loading; all six selected bricks run. Real native Steam integration, overlay, alternate skin/DPI and physical-device acceptance remain unverified. Customer distribution and Steam Deck remain deferred. Consumers update manually.

bricks.name: Geurts Game Forge Angels

Fixed type/category, bounded previews, uncertainty/collision skips, source/context guards, no paid retries or bulk migration. Images/materials only; model accuracy is not guaranteed. Requires Commandments 0.50.0 / Forge Setup 1.3.0 for Codex mode. Unity 6000.6.3f1: 267 passed, zero failed, 2 conditional checks skipped; real visual connection, actual child cancellation/120-second timeout/cleanup, supported examples and normal/narrow rendered controls verified. Physical input and alternate skin/DPI remain unverified. Consumer updates stay manual.
